title: Stats
author: @lunokjod
description: What the machine costs and where the time went: the bars of the meters the kernel keeps, ordered by what they cost, the pie of the four families with its legend, a Load tab that samples the load of the system and the memory in use every ten seconds and draws them over half an hour of history, kept in a session that comes back when the page does and fed by a minute tick of the system while the board is awake, the memory and what this board is. The look of the LogApp of the paper project (dark bars, a pie, ordered numbers) on the controls this system already has.
